title: Autonomous Farm Operating Policy
objective: Protect yield and cash flow while using existing land efficiently. Prefer evidence-backed, reversible actions and never execute an action that violates a state guardrail.
notes: The agent should explain which policy fields affected every recommendation.

name: Wheat
decisionRules: Water growing wheat when moisture falls below 40%.
Avoid unnecessary planting when seed inventory is insufficient.

name: Water a growing plot
preconditions: Current moisture must be below the crop moisture floor.
The action must not push moisture above 100%.
safetyGuardrails: Do not water ready or harvestable plots.
Re-evaluate the plot after the next observation.
explanation: Watering is a protective intervention intended to prevent crop stress before the next growth step.

name: Harvest a mature plot
preconditions: Growth must be at harvest readiness.
safetyGuardrails: Never harvest into a full inventory.
Reset the tile to ready after successful harvest.
explanation: Harvest at readiness to convert mature field value into inventory without wasting the harvest window.

name: Plant a ready plot
preconditions: At least one seed must be available.
safetyGuardrails: Do not plant without seed inventory.
Keep planting decisions consistent with the active crop profile.
explanation: Planting expands productive area only when the current resource state supports another cycle.

name: Wheat cash-flow rule
rules: Prefer a partial sale when demand is at least 75% and the trend is rising.
Avoid selling the full inventory when future value is materially higher.
Preserve at least 20% inventory capacity for the next harvest window.
rationale: The farm should capture strong demand while retaining flexibility for future price movement.
